sources: https://www.camplife.com/381/reservation/step1 (CampLife booking API: reservation session and site records for campground 381, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Free permit booked through the District's CampLife reservation system (a free account is needed, and availability shows only once logged in). Up to 7 nights per reservation; no more than two reservations at a time or in a 30-day period.

booking.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/econfina-creek/tom-johns-landing/ ('Four campsites are available by reservation', 'Reserve' link to camplife.com/381) + https://nwfwater.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Step-by-Step-Instructions-on-How-to-Make-A-Camping-Reservation.pdf ('A reservation can be made for up to seven (7) nights. No more than two (2) reservations can be booked at a time or in a 30 day period'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/econfina-creek/tom-johns-landing/ ('While RV camping is allowed at the two sites, power, water, or waste disposal hookups are not available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Four sites: Sites 1-2 tent-only, Sites 3-4 back-in for tents, travel trailers and RVs (CampLife equipment: motorhome, travel trailer, fifth wheel, van, fold-down). CampLife lists every site as 50 ft, which looks like a default rather than a measured length, so no max rig length is recorded.

sites.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/econfina-creek/tom-johns-landing/ ('Four campsites are available by reservation. Two of those sites are for tent-only (no RVs) camping. The other two sites can be used for tents, travel trailers, and RVs.') + CampLife session for campground 381 (Sites 1-2 'Tent', Sites 3-4 'Back-in'), read 2026-10-21

note: Northwest Florida Water Management District landing at the north end of Porter Lake in the Econfina Creek WMA, about 22 miles south of Chipley, reached by Porter Pond Road (signed at each major intersection). Pavilion, picnic tables, fire rings, pedestal grills, portable toilet, boat ramp. Site length is not published - primitive sites on unpaved access; check the site diagram before bringing a big rig. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the District page and its CampLife records: 4 reservation-only sites (2 tent-only, 2 back-in RV/trailer sites), no hookups, 7-night limit, free. No storm-closure banner on the page and not on the District's closures list (2026-10-21). Note trimmed of the count/hookup/booking facts the fields carry. Not stated: real max rig length (CampLife's 50 ft looks like a default), season, potable water.
flags: Only 2 of the 4 sites take RVs; site length unpublished (CampLife's 50 ft on every site looks like a default). No 4WD statement - 'Motorized vehicles allowed on designated roads only.'
Availability on CampLife is shown only to a logged-in (free) account; camping is free, so no rate is hidden.
